purpose: Generate a deterministic OWASP ASVS 5.0.0 evidence inventory from the exact pinned public standard without claiming compliance before every applicable requirement has evidence.
requiredInvariants: OWASP ASVS 5.0.0 is read only from the exact public upstream release commit 5cf9b032440be53ce345ab3c130fda46ba1ce7a2 and its exact SHA-256 8201b20eec2908c3380ac600c91c8ba746346fbb808859366abb232027532311.
No application source, crown-jewel content, secret, credential or production data may be uploaded to OWASP or any external scanner/service.
The generated evidence must not reproduce ASVS requirement descriptions; it may contain identifiers, levels, statuses and evidence references only.
Unknown requirements remain NOT_ASSESSED and pending applicability remains explicit; no existing security gate may be translated into an inferred ASVS PASS.
Final ASVS PASS is impossible while any applicable requirement is NOT_ASSESSED or FAIL or while applicability review remains pending.
No product code, dependency, lockfile, database, DNS, REG.RU runtime or production configuration may change.
Merge and CI success are not ASVS compliance or REG.RU production evidence.
acceptance: The exact pinned ASVS source validates as 345 unique well-formed requirements at levels 1 through 3 and matches its pinned SHA-256.
Malformed schema, duplicate or malformed requirement identifiers, invalid levels, wrong requirement counts and source-byte drift fail closed.
ASVS_MATRIX.csv and ASVS_SUMMARY.json are deterministic and included in the immutable IP evidence bundle.
The matrix contains no requirement prose and the summary records proprietarySourceUploaded=false.
The IP evidence verifier independently validates matrix shape, counts, digest, statuses, applicability and final-pass consistency.
Offline unit tests cover the evidence builder and the concurrent-scope guard accepts exactly the five authorized paths.
